admitted: Public tail compress_marks : Bool = false, independent of MRK3/MRK4

Existing finite static and recursive JSON/Dynamic codecs/grids reused without new logical types/sites/profiles
rejected: Unknown or mixed mark layouts, declaration/hash mismatch and over-budget physical/canonical output
Publication after failed staged readback; existing strict reader rejection remains
preconditions: Canonical-file bytes already precharged by the production caller before CompactPhysicalMarkOutput
Publisher-owned quiescent staging directory and quiescent read parts
guard_only: Literal LZ4 framing qualifies format validity, not size reduction
Temporary evidence and scratch auditor must be regenerated if unavailable
not_admitted: All types/profile/layout cross products or arbitrary root Dynamic/wrapper ownership
Arbitrary-key writer, incremental append, concurrent-stage mutation protection
Independent decompressor/CityHash implementation, granule-only I/O, RSS/speed parity
Complete MV/projection composition or global goal completion
